title: Serenity by the Sea 30A | Real Joy

description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* 1-Minute Bike Ride to Wall Street Public Beach Access * Panoramic Gulf Views – Relax on multiple covered balconies while taking in beautiful coastal views* Pet Friendly – Up to 2 approved, non-aggressive dogs with approval and additional $250 fee* Heated Community Pool * Private Elevator– Convenient access throughout the home; adult use only* Game Room – Enjoy foosball, Xbox, board games, and a Smart TV* 6-Minute Walk to 30Avenues – Enjoy dining and shopping, including Amici 30A Italian Kitchen* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Serenity by the Sea 30A, a stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom luxury home in beautiful Inlet Beach! Designed with families and groups in mind, this spacious retreat comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests. It offers panoramic Gulf views, a seasonally heated community pool, and an unbeatable location just a short bike ride from the beach. Start your morning by relaxing on one of the home's covered balconies, where you can enjoy beautiful views of the Gulf and community pool.Inside offers spacious living areas designed for gathering and relaxing. The main living area features a cozy fireplace, creating a welcoming setting for family meals and evenings together. The fully equipped kitchen features high-end stainless-steel appliances to prepare meals for the entire group. Sleeping accommodations include five King suites, each featuring its own ensuite bathroom and Smart TV. Two Queen sleeper sofas, located on the 2nd and 4th floors, provide additional sleeping space for 14 guests. Serenity by the Sea 30A offers the perfect combination of luxury, convenience, and relaxation.The Bed Setup:1st Floor: Bedroom 1: King Bedroom 2nd Floor:Bedroom 2: King BedroomLiving Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa3rd Floor:Bedroom 3: King Bedroom 4th Floor:Bedroom 4: King Bedroom Bedroom 5: King Bedroom Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
